title: Raw rational localization of integral adjunction and purity
statement: For P,E and an integral functor F between the intrinsic constructible categories, Localization records its raw rational extension on unchanged integral objects and with map c tensor f sent to c tensor F(f). The residue-field inverse of ell is the image of the unit supplied by P. rationalPuritySource is the existing rational derived pullback followed by intrinsic twist (d) and shift [2d]. For an IntegralModel, RationalModel consists of these literal localizations of support, exceptional functor and purity source, the identification of the last with rationalPuritySource, their adjunction with localized unit and counit, and the purity isomorphism whose components are the localizations of the actual integral purity maps. No idempotent completion is made. Built from [def-sp-field-extension-integral-models], [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. sourceIdentification_normalized fixes its component on every integral representative to the localization of the actual shifted tensor completion unit sourceCompletion. Thus automorphisms of the rational source cannot change this identification. The normalization definitions are [def-sp-field-extension-source-normalization]. The displayed normalization then composes with the canonical localization/shift isomorphism for [2d], so it does not equate distinct shift object presentations.
